paper_title: Searching for axion-like particles with ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions
suggested_experiment_name: LHC Pb-Pb UPC (photon fusion, 1 nb^-1 projection)
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda in GeV^-1 as plotted on y-axis, with Lagrangian -(1/4)(a/Lambda) F Ftilde, i.e. g_agamma = 1/Lambda
notes: Paper's headline result is a PROJECTED sensitivity for ALP->gamma gamma production in ultra-peripheral Pb-Pb collisions at the LHC (1 nb^-1 and 10 nb^-1), covering 5-100 GeV in ALP mass on the 1/Lambda vs m_a plane (Fig. 4). It also derives NEW recast exclusion limits from OPAL 2-gamma/3-gamma (LEP II) and ATLAS multi-photon searches (100 MeV - 100 GeV), so both is_new_limit and is_projection are set true. No numerical table is provided; the data_points above are approximate anchors reconstructed from the text: benchmark signal points (m_a=15 GeV, Lambda=17 TeV -> 1/Lambda=5.9e-5 GeV^-1; m_a=40 GeV, Lambda=8 TeV -> 1.25e-4 GeV^-1) and rough endpoint estimates of the 1 nb^-1 Pb-Pb sensitivity curve in Fig. 4 (left, aF Ftilde coupling). Endpoint values (5 and 100 GeV) are visual estimates and carry significant uncertainty. Coupling type unambiguous (photon coupling), but data quality limited (no table, figure-only). Not a dark matter search; no DM density assumption.
